faq_search_title: How do I search for a sample?
faq_search_step_words: Type a few words in the search bar on the home page, such as a sample name or an IGSN, then press “Search”.
faq_search_step_location: Looking for samples from a region? Click “Add location”, then “Draw an area” and click two opposite corners on the map (or hold Shift and drag). You can search by words, by area, or both.
faq_search_step_filters: On the results page, use the filters to narrow things down by type, material, age, collector and more. Remove a filter from its chip, or start over with “Clear all filters”.
faq_search_step_map: Click “See on map” to see where your results were collected, and open any result to see its full description.
faq_search_rules_title: How does the search find samples?
faq_search_rule_fields: It looks in each sample’s name, specific name and local ID, and finds the samples containing all the words you typed. You can also type an IGSN to find that exact sample.
faq_search_rule_case: No need to worry about capitals or accents: “rhone” also finds “Rhône”.
faq_search_rule_typo: Small typos are forgiven in words of 5 letters or more: “basslt” still finds “basalt”.
faq_search_rule_wildcard: Not sure of the spelling? Use the “*” wildcard in place of any letters: “bas*lt” finds “basalt”.
faq_search_rule_limits: Keep it short: only the first 6 words are used, and single letters are skipped.
faq_search_rule_area: When searching by location, draw an area no bigger than a quarter of the globe. A larger area turns red and is not searched.
faq_search_rule_published: Only published samples are shown. Sub-samples are hidden by default: turn on “Include sub-samples” in the filters to see them.
